name: B-25 control wheel
view: the pilot's control wheel from the left seat: the large round hub with the two curved horns sweeping up and out to the grips, the gun firing button on top of the left grip (position not confirmed), the column below
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the wheel's outline reconstructed from the War Thunder B-25J description, the B-25 pilot's manual text and public museum and airworthy B-25 cockpit photos looked at for proportions; the gun button's place on the wheel is not confirmed from a manual. Not traced from a photo.
